inventory_name: Hydrus reference GUI nested feature inventory

status_definitions.first_pass: Existing native behavior with documented/behavioral/oracle evidence; intentionally limited, never complete Qt parity.
status_definitions.partial: Native feature area exists with known omitted controls/workflows or meaningful behavior differences.
status_definitions.missing: Concrete Python feature exists and docs/native UI explicitly defer its native GUI or workflow. Runtime/preservation/interchange support may still exist.
status_definitions.unassessed: Reference feature found; precise native behavior/coverage not evaluated.

counting_rules: Nodes represent user-visible semantic features, dialogs and workflows rather than individual raw Qt widgets.
Feature_scope edges are organizational; direct_symbol edges give concrete parent-child mentions.
Shared references use target_id and should not count as independently implemented editors.
Descendant counts do not expand shared targets recursively and do not imply maximum modal stack depth. Nested/zipper formulas allow recursive nesting beyond this finite tree.
Use this selected inventory to navigate breadth and gaps; it is not an exhaustive whole-client coverage denominator.
Existing evidence filenames do not certify all controls and no tests were executed. Native module source anchors do not equate callbacks with parity.
unique_reachable_feature_count_including_shared expands shared editor targets once with cycle protection; useful for visualizer breadth, not a parity percentage.
limitations: Preparatory snapshot while root integrates third slate; viewer construction is a later task.
No repository sources edited; only this JSON artifact written.
Older DIFFERENCES prose conflicts with newer GUI.md around clear/load sessions and auto-resolution review; those stale claims were not used to mark either missing.
Options status concerns native settings-window exposure, not imported data preservation or backend support.
All six formula kinds/subsidiary parsers can execute and round-trip while dedicated native editors remain missing.
Menus show availability and reference layout; those fixtures alone do not establish each callback behavior.
